title: Music Matters Live 2026 Spotlights Xonara and More Filipino Talent | One Music PH
summary: P-Pop groups XONARA, KAIA and PIX!E, as well as OPM band Lola Amour join the 21st anniversary of Music Matters Live at CQ @ Clarke Quay, Singapore on Oct. 2 to 4.
